next_step: Agree on eval success criteria + run 2-week A/B canary with Redwood dedicated pool
notes: Primary contact: Head of Search Eng, Melissa Gordon (melissa.g@cascadeinsight.com)
Background: in-house RAG search for contracts + precedents; currently using hybrid pipeline: OpenAI embeddings + TF-based reranker; wants lower unit cost and on-prem options for sensitive clients.
Scale: ~18M indexed passages (contracts + clauses); ingest rate ~50k docs/month; expect growth to 40M in 12 months.
Latency / throughput targets: p50 <= 120ms for reranker (90% of queries under 300ms), sustained 150 qps for peak windows, burst to 400 qps.
Cost sensitivity: target end-to-end cost per query < $0.01 (embeddings + retrieval + rerank); current cost estimated ~$0.025/query with OpenAI + custom ranking infra.
Model preference: open to Mistral and Llama-family embeddings if quality matches; interested in Redwood's curated embeddings + reranker suggestion that reduce token billing.
Routing/fallback: must support region routing (NA primary, EU for EU customers) and automatic fallback to cheaper quantized variant if dedicated pool saturated.
Security/compliance: strict client contracts require data residency (EU for EU clients), SSO/SAML for console + RBAC, audit logs retention 7 years for some law-firm customers.
POC plan (discussed):
- Week 0: ingest 1M doc subset + baseline metrics (current pipeline) — compute MRR/NDCG and latency histogram
- Week 1: deploy Redwood embeddings (candidate model A) + existing reranker, run shadow indexing and collect evals
- Week 2: enable Redwood reranker candidate; run A/B split 10% traffic -> 90% baseline for live queries (canary), monitor evals and error rates
- Success gates: no >5% drop in recall@10 and <2% drop in MRR; latency p50 within 1.2x baseline; cost per query reduction >= 30% for embedding + rerank leg.

Evals approach: will use Redwood evals harness + account's in-house labeled query set (5k queries, relevance graded). Plan for automated daily regression alerts and manual review of top-50 regressions.
Notes from discovery call 2024-10-30 (ff-20241030-DA98): 'If we see even subtle regressions on precedent retrieval we can't push to prod — legal teams will reject', Melissa quoted.

Technical blockers called out: need neuron-level token accounting for reranker (to model cost), KV cache behavior with long contracts (avg seq length 2.3k tokens), and deterministic reranker reproducibility for audits.
Operations ask: canary + automated rollback via Redwood Console, per-route latency/cost dashboards, and ability to pin model versions per customer region.
Commercial: procurement needs SOW for Dedicated pool with three-month trial pricing, and an on-prem option quote for highest-tier clients.
Next meeting scheduled: 2024-11-27 demo of dedicated pool performance (Jordan / Priya / Melissa) — drive deck link in docs.
Action items assigned: SE to produce baseline NDCG/MRR export (Priya), AE to draft pricing SOW (Jordan), Legal to send residency checklist (Melissa's team).
Short-term risk: if evals show label disagreement on ~7% of queries, team expects additional label refresh + third-party annotation (will push timeline by ~2-3 weeks).
